sections.title: Arcs, chords & inscribed angles
facts: Inscribed angle $= \frac{1}{2}$ its arc; central angle $=$ its arc.
Angle in a semicircle $= 90^\circ$; cyclic quadrilateral: opposite angles add to $180^\circ$.

sections.title: Tangents
facts: Two tangents from one point are equal; with an incircle, $AB + CD = BC + DA$.
Common tangents: external $\sqrt{d^2 - (r_1 - r_2)^2}$, internal $\sqrt{d^2 - (r_1 + r_2)^2}$.

sections.title: Power of a point
facts: $PA \cdot PB = PC \cdot PD$ for any two lines through $P$.
Inside, at distance $d$: $PA \cdot PB = r^2 - d^2$.

sections.title: Areas with circles
facts: Segment $=$ sector $-$ triangle; ring $= \pi R^2 - \pi r^2$.
